hero.subtitle: Agri Grid connects farmers, workers, equipment owners, warehouses, transporters, and buyers on one intelligent platform — reducing waste, cutting costs, and growing prosperity.
hero.trusted: Trusted by agricultural stakeholders across Africa

stakeholders.title: One Platform,
stakeholders.subtitle: Agri Grid serves every participant in the agricultural value chain with tailored tools and connections.
stakeholders.farmersDesc: List your produce, find workers, rent equipment, and connect with buyers — all from one dashboard.
stakeholders.workersDesc: Find seasonal and permanent agricultural jobs that match your skills and location preferences.
stakeholders.rentersDesc: List your machinery and tools for rent. Reach farmers who need them, when they need them.
stakeholders.warehouseDesc: Monetize your storage space. Connect with farmers and buyers who need safe storage solutions.
stakeholders.transportersDesc: Find loads that match your route and vehicle. Reduce empty return trips and maximize earnings.
stakeholders.buyersDesc: Source quality produce directly from farmers. Compare prices, arrange transport, and manage orders.

howItWorks.title: How
howItWorks.subtitle: Get started in four simple steps and unlock the full power of Africa's agricultural network.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Sign up and tell us your role — farmer, buyer, transporter, or any combination.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Post your produce, equipment, or services — or browse what others are offering.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Message stakeholders directly. Agree on prices, logistics, and timelines.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Complete transactions, build your reputation, and expand your agricultural network.

cta.subtitle: Join thousands of farmers, workers, and buyers already growing together on Agri Grid.
